opportunities.name: Research GitHub candidate and email a hiring lead
opportunities.description: For a given GitHub username and role, look up the user's profile and top repo on GitHub, then draft an email to the hiring address summarising followers, top repo stars/language and latest blog post.
steps: On GitHub, open 'Search or jump to' and type the {username}, press Enter
Note follower count, open the top/pinned repo and note stars and language
Find the person's latest blog post title (from profile/website)
In mail, compose a new message To = {recipient}
Body = '{username}: {followers} followers, top repo {repo} ({stars} stars, {language}), latest post: {latest_post}.'

instances.values: username=karpathy, role=ML Research Engineer, repo=nanoGPT (63.8k, Python), followers=226k, post=microgpt

opportunities.name: Look up a person on Wikipedia and an archived company homepage, then save a note
opportunities.description: For a given person, search Wikipedia for their birth date and role, look up their organisation's website on the Wayback Machine for a given year, and save a summary note.
steps: Search Wikipedia for {person} and press Enter
Note birth date and current role
On the Wayback Machine, enter {site_url} and press Enter
Select year {year} and click a capture date
In notes, add a new note: '{person}: born {birth_date}, {role}. {site_url} in {year}: {headline}.' and press Enter

instances.values: person=Satya Nadella, site=microsoft.com, year=2014 (finished, note saved)
